agent.summary:
**Cause:** The `profile` deployment in `test-hotel-reservation` had the wrong container command. It ran `geo`, not `profile`. The pod looked healthy, but it was running the geo service on port 8083 and registering in Consul as `srv-geo`. Nothing was serving profile requests.

**Fix:** I patched the deployment so the container command is `profile`. The new pod is Running. Its logs show the profile service starting and registering in Consul as `srv-profile` on port 8081.

I only checked the pod status and logs. I didn't send a test request through the frontend. I didn't look at the other services beyond the pod list, where everything was Running.
